tags: @guarantee ok.initial the value starts at `initialValue`, 0 when it is not given
@guarantee ok.increment `increment` adds `step` to the value, `decrement` subtracts it
@guarantee ok.bounds the value never goes above `max` or below `min`
@guarantee ok.set `set` sets the value to the given number, within `min` and `max`
@guarantee ok.reset `reset` sets the value back to `initialValue`
@guarantee ok.initial the state starts at `initialState`, false when it is not given
@guarantee ok.handlers `open` sets the state to true, `close` to false, `toggle` to its opposite and `set` to the given value
@guarantee ok.callbacks `onOpen` is called when the state changes to true and `onClose` when it changes to false
@guarantee ok.no-change `open` when already open and `close` when already closed do nothing and call no callback
@guarantee ok.first the value starts at the first element of `options`
@guarantee ok.cycle calling the toggle function with no argument moves the value to the next element of `options`, and from the last back to the first (["light", "dark"]: "dark", then "light")
@guarantee ok.force calling the toggle function with a value sets the value to it
@guarantee ok.boolean without `options`, the value starts at false and toggles between false and true

@guarantee ok.range with total 10 and page 1, range is [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, "dots", 10]; on page 5 it is [1, "dots", 4, 5, 6, "dots", 10]; on page 6 [1, "dots", 5, 6, 7, "dots", 10]; on page 10 [1, "dots", 6, 7, 8, 9, 10]
@guarantee ok.defaults `siblings` and `boundaries` default to 1, and the first page defaults to 1 or `startValue`
@guarantee ok.navigation `next`, `previous`, `first` and `last` move the active page to the next, previous, first and last page
@guarantee ok.controlled with `page` and `onChange`, `setPage` calls `onChange` with the page and the active page follows `page`
@guarantee ok.siblings `siblings` sets how many pages are shown on each side of the active page
@guarantee ok.boundaries `boundaries` sets how many pages are shown at each edge
@guarantee ok.start-value with `startValue` 5 and `total` 15, the pages range from 5 to 15
@guarantee ok.initial `initialValues` (default empty) are divided between state and queue: the first `limit` items in state, the rest in queue
@guarantee ok.add `add` puts items in state while state holds fewer than `limit` items, and in queue after that
@guarantee ok.update `update` applies the function to all items of state and queue, then divides the result again by `limit`, keeping order
@guarantee ok.clean `cleanQueue` empties the queue and leaves state unchanged
@guarantee ok.values returns one of "undetermined", "macos", "ios", "windows", "android", "linux" and "chromeos", according to the user agent
@guarantee ok.undetermined returns "undetermined" when the OS cannot be identified, for example during server-side rendering
